app.name: LiveLingo
app.permission.title: System Permission Required
app.permission.body:
LiveLingo needs two macOS permissions to register global hotkeys:

1. Privacy & Security → Accessibility
2. Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring

Add and enable LiveLingo (or the terminal app you run it from during development) in BOTH lists.
After granting, restart the app.
app.hotkey.registrationFailed.title: Hotkey Registration Failed
app.hotkey.registrationFailed.body:
Could not register "{0}".

The key combination may conflict with another application, or the required system permissions are not granted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hotkey.desc: Open the composer in any app
settings.hotkey.invalid: Invalid hotkey. Include one key, for example Ctrl+Alt+T.
settings.commit.desc: Shift+Enter inserts a line break; IME confirmation comes first
settings.language.desc: Applies when a window is opened again
settings.theme.desc: Light, dark or follow the system
settings.motion.desc: Turns off the composer and recording animations
settings.mic.desc: The input device used for dictation
settings.cleanup.desc: Removes fillers and repetitions; off offers only the original wording
settings.output.desc: Where an app with no remembered choice begins
settings.autoDictate.desc: Speak right after the summon shortcut; when off, press the dictation shortcut in the window to start
settings.preload.desc: Loads the speech models in the background so the first dictation does not wait. They take about 1.5 GB of memory while loaded and are released after 30 idle minutes; when off, they start loading each time you summon the composer
settings.remember: Remember the last choice for each app
settings.remember.desc: Stores only the app identifier, the output and the translation direction — never titles, text or recordings. Kept on this device; see and clear it under Privacy & cloud
settings.polish.desc: When you stop recording, the whole dictation is polished once more by these requirements (joining sentences the pauses cut apart, removing fillers and repetitions, fixing homophones). Write only the style you want; the fidelity rules (no new facts, no change of meaning, numbers and negations kept) always apply and cannot be edited away. A saved text that is not usable (too short, too long or damaged) is replaced by the default
settings.polish.invalid: The requirements need 10–1500 characters; not saved, the previous ones are still used
settings.polish.save: Saved when you leave the box
settings.terms.hint: Identical term and translation means keep as written (speech recognition, cleanup and the fidelity check use it).
settings.cloud.translate.desc: Off by default. Needs its own consent
settings.cloud.baseUrl.desc: Only text is sent, never audio; must be https
settings.cloud.model.desc: For example a Microsoft Foundry deployment name
settings.cloud.apiKey.desc: Kept in the system secret store, never in a file
settings.cloud.keyStored: A key is stored; leave empty to keep it
settings.cloud.invalid: Enter an https endpoint, a model name and an API key to use the cloud.
settings.consent.body: When on, the text of that step is sent to the service you configured. Audio is never uploaded.
settings.recent.desc: The last 5 are kept in memory and cleared when the app exits
settings.apps.desc: The output and direction last chosen for each app. They never expire; past 50 apps the one used longest ago is forgotten first
settings.model.desc: Quality first or speed first; never switches to the cloud silently
settings.legacy.desc: {0} models ({1} GB) downloaded by an earlier version are no longer used; nothing is deleted unless you ask
settings.version.desc: Models and runtimes are downloaded only after you agree
settings.update.desc: Looks for a new version at start and every few hours, and downloads it in the background
settings.update.ready: Version {0} is downloaded. Restart to install it; quitting installs it too.
settings.update.latest: You are on the latest version ({0}). Checked {1}.
settings.update.unsupported: This copy was not installed with the LiveLingo installer (Setup.exe or .pkg), so it cannot update itself. Install the latest version from the download page.
settings.update.off: Updates are turned off (Update.UpdateUrl is empty in settings.json).
settings.diag.desc: Contains no text, terms, addresses or keys; handy when asking for help
settings.diag.title: Status (no text included)
